changeSet.author: dev
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE p_script_plugin_ai_setting ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, singleton_key VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Singleton key; always DEFAULT', daily_generation_limit INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 20 COMMENT 'Per-user generations per day; 0 disables the limit', max_tokens_per_call INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 4096 COMMENT 'Output token cap per model call', max_attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 3 COMMENT 'Retry cap; values above 3 are clamped to 3', version BIGINT NULL, create_time BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, create_user VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', update_time BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, update_user VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_ai_setting_singleton (singleton_key) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COMMENT 'Script plugin AI settings (singleton)';

changeSet.author: dev
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE p_script_plugin_ai_generation ( id BIGINT NOT NULL, plugin_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, user_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, model VARCHAR(64) NULL, prompt_version VARCHAR(32) NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL COMMENT 'RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED', attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, prompt_tokens INT NULL, completion_tokens INT NULL, duration_ms BIGINT NULL, error_message VARCHAR(1024) NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, finished_at BIGINT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (id), KEY idx_ai_generation_plugin (plugin_key, id), KEY idx_ai_generation_user (user_name, created_at) ) ENGINE = InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4 COMMENT 'Script plugin AI generation audit';
